[tool.codeclone]
# The switch that made this stage necessary: api-surface collection is OFF
# by default, so neither wire-freeze corpus carried a single api_surface
# row (measured 0 of 0 on both) and the lane's identity spelling was never
# seen by the ingest oracle on real producer output.  Turning it on here is
# the whole point of the stage.
api_surface = true
# Semantic authority is required, not decorative: the full-run ingest
# oracle refuses a document whose ``source_facts.semantic`` is null
# (measured verbatim: "source_facts.semantic is not an object"), so a stage
# meant to be ingested whole must carry it — as both stages above do.
semantic_authority = true
